summary: The timed outer loop invokes the GPU helper exactly iterations times; its launch grid assigns a warp to each row, lanes traverse the row's nonzeros, and reduction writes one row result. The sole sm_75 SASS variant has the thread/warp bounds, retained DFMA traversal backedge and output store.

source_evidence.claim: Warp row mapping and lane-strided CSR traversal feed a warp reduction and row output. CLI iteration count and matrix setup flow into a timed loop calling spmvGpu once per iteration; the helper launches work for the dimension, synchronizes and copies output.
The selected CUDA target architecture is sm_75, the final SASS variant reviewed.

compiled_evidence.claim: Timed loop starts at 1272, calls spmvGpu at 1286, increments/compares/backedges at 1288-1290. Its compiled helper path launches the kernel, calls cudaDeviceSynchronize at ba15 and copies device output at ba37 before returning.

compiled_evidence.claim: The sm_75 kernel computes a warp's row index, compares it to dim and exits invalid rows. Separate lane/row-end predicates control CSR work; cited DFMA/body ranges include the nonzero-loop backedge, and the final range contains the row-result store.

primary_quality_check.method: Primary read every submitted claim and independently inspected complete CC5.5 CUDA r4 source/build, exact measured host loop and full final SASS. Primary detected incorrect copied helper synchronization, row-guard and warp-mapping descriptions in the first proposal and returned the whole batch to Luna for exact-file reaudit. Version2 corrects these; other findings rely on Luna's reaudit plus primary report and pinned-evidence checks.
corrections: Used version2 after full batch reaudit; original proposal preserved.
Expanded references to complete cited source/build files.
Retained complete short r4 final SASS function so row guard, empty-CSR guard, arithmetic backedges and store remain together.
